knowledge_versions_owner_check.name: knowledge_versions_owner_check
knowledge_versions_owner_check.value:
("knowledge_versions"."tier" = 'agency' and "knowledge_versions"."client_id" is null and "knowledge_versions"."project_id" is null)
        or ("knowledge_versions"."tier" = 'client' and "knowledge_versions"."client_id" is not null and "knowledge_versions"."project_id" is null)
        or ("knowledge_versions"."tier" = 'project' and "knowledge_versions"."project_id" is not null and "knowledge_versions"."client_id" is null)

rule_candidates_source_check.name: rule_candidates_source_check
rule_candidates_source_check.value: (case when "rule_candidates"."review_event_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) + (case when "rule_candidates"."derivative_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) + (case when "rule_candidates"."plan_feedback_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) = 1
